content.title: Walmart Holiday Hours 2025 | Christmas, Christmas Eve, Thanksgiving Day hours
content.text: A Walmart logo is displayed outside one of their stores on August 2, 2025 in San Diego, California.Getty ImagesIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By Josie Howell | jhowell@al.comThe holiday season is one of Walmart’s busiest times, and knowing when stores are open (or closed) can save you a last-minute headache. From Thanksgiving closures to Black Friday openings, here’s a breakdown of Walmart’s holiday schedule in an easy FAQ format.What holidays is Walmart closed?Walmart stores are closed on Thanksgiving Day and Christmas Day each year. These are the only two major holidays when doors remain shut nationwide.What holidays is Walmart open, and what are the hours?For most federal holidays, Walmart keeps normal hours, which are 6 a.m. to 11 p.m. local time. This includes:New Year’s DayPresidents’ DayEaster SundayMemorial DayIndependence DayLabor DayColumbus DayVeterans DayRELATED: Is a Walmart+ membership worth it? 5 benefits of being a memberWhat are Walmart’s Christmas Eve hours?Most locations close early (about 6 p.m.) on Christmas Eve (verify your local store’s hours). Shoppers should plan ahead for last-minute essentials.What are Walmart’s Black Friday hours?In recent years, Walmart stores have opened around 6 a.m. local time on Black Friday and operated through the evening. Check your store’s listing for exact hours.Do Walmart departments follow the same holiday hours?Not always. Departments such as the pharmacy, auto center, vision center, deli, bakery, and curbside pickup may close earlier or operate on reduced schedules even if the main store is open.How can I find my local Walmart’s holiday hours?Use the Walmart Store Finder on Walmart.com or the Walmart app. Hours can vary slightly by region, so it’s best to double-check before heading out.Does Walmart extend its return policy during the holidays?Yes. Purchases made between October 1 and December 31 typically fall under Walmart’s extended return policy, meaning most items can be returned through January 31 of the following year.Are there any special holiday services?Some Walmart stores offer sensory-friendly shopping hours during the holidays. These usually take place in the mornings (e.g. 8 a.m. to 10 a.m.) to create a calmer environment for customers with sensory sensitivities.Holiday / OccasionExpected HoursThanksgiving DayClosedChristmas DayClosedChristmas EveCloses early, around 6 p.m.Black FridayOpens ~6 a.m., closes 11 p.m.Most Other Federal HolidaysOpen ~6 a.m. to 11 p.m.Department-Specific HoursMay vary—check locallyReturn PolicyExtended: purchases in Oct–Dec can be returned through Jan 31Store LocatorUse Walmart Store Finder or AppSensory-Friendly ShoppingSome stores offer early morning windowsOverall, Walmart keeps things simple. Stores are closed only on Thanksgiving and Christmas Day, with early closures on Christmas Eve and early openings on Black Friday.
